Game Overview

In Mew Cat 2, the core idea is straightforward: embark on a whimsical journey in Mew Cat 2, where clever platforming meets adorable chaos. Dodge hostile cats and tricky obstacles while mastering your double jump to claim delectable cat treats. With eight thrilling levels, perfect timing and agile maneuvers will unlock the gateway to endless feline fun.
